_comment: Registry of the Microsoft first-party pages this skill reads.
`raw` is the Learn article source on GitHub (MicrosoftDocs/sql-docs, live branch),
which is what the parser consumes. `live` is the rendered Learn URL that gets cited
in the output. Keep the two in sync when adding a page.

vcore_single.reads: Every vCore service-level objective (GP_/BC_/HS_ names) plus the published Memory (GB) row for each.

dtu_single.reads: Basic, S0-S12 and P1-P15 compute sizes with their DTU and storage limits.

dtu_pools.reads: Basic, Standard and Premium elastic pool eDTU sizes.

mi_limits.reads: The vCore grid per hardware generation and service tier, memory ratios and caps.

mi_vcore_model.reads: ARM SKU names (GP_Gen5, GP_G8IM, GP_G8IH, BC_*) and the when-to-choose sections.

vcore_model.reads: Hardware configurations, when-to-choose sections, Fsv2 and Gen4 retirement notices.

dtu_model.reads: Basic/Standard/Premium comparison, IOPS and latency, sub-vCore warnings.

serverless.reads: Scenarios suited to serverless vs provisioned compute; supported tier and hardware matrix.

hyperscale.reads: Hyperscale scale, replica and storage-billing characteristics.

mi_nextgen.reads: Next-gen General Purpose characteristics and when to choose it.

whats_new_db.reads: Current preview feature list and GA entries from the last 12 months.

whats_new_db_archive.reads: Dated hardware and compute-size announcements for previous years.

whats_new_mi.reads: Current Managed Instance preview list and recent GA entries.

whats_new_mi_archive.reads: Dated Managed Instance hardware, vCore and service-tier announcements.
